description: Search people by keywords and filters, read FRESH at request time. Returns the first 1,000 results per query; page with `start`. Costs $0.012 per live read. Give `keywords` or at least one filter.

filters.description: Named filters: network, current_company, past_company, location, industry, school, profile_language, connection_of, service_category, first_name, last_name, title, company, school_name.

start.description: Zero-based offset into the first 1,000 results.

name: people_search
title: Search People
